cases.title: Discard password when Never For This Site is selected
cases.description: Verify that when a user triggers the save password prompt and selects Never For This Site, the browser discards the password and does not save it.

cases.title: Never For This Site selection prevents future prompts and retains site accessibility
cases.description: Verify that selecting Never For This Site prevents subsequent save prompts for the same site while leaving normal site navigation and login functioning without stored credentials.

cases.title: Present multiple saved usernames and passwords for a website
cases.description: Verify that when multiple usernames and passwords are saved for a website, all of those choices are later available to be presented to the user upon login.

cases.title: Present choices correctly when a single set versus multiple sets of credentials exist
cases.description: Verify the boundary condition where transition from a single saved credential to multiple saved credentials correctly updates the presented choices on the login form.

cases.title: Update saved password upon change
cases.description: Verify that when a username and password for a website are already saved, and the user subsequently changes the password and logs in successfully, the password manager captures the new password.

cases.title: Prompt to update changed password
cases.description: Verify that the password manager prompts the user to update the stored password when a modified password is submitted for an existing account.

cases.title: Verify disabling password manager suppresses save prompts and autofill
cases.description: Disable the password manager from the preferences panel, then navigate to a login site to verify that the browser no longer asks to save passwords and no longer prefills credential information.

cases.title: View saved credentials in preferences
cases.description: Verify that when a username and password are saved in the password manager, the saved information can be successfully viewed within the password manager through the preferences panel.

cases.title: View empty list in preferences when no credentials are saved
cases.description: Verify that the password manager list in the preferences panel correctly displays as empty when no usernames and passwords have been saved.

cases.title: Remove single specific credential entry for a site
cases.description: Verify that when a specific username and password entry is removed from the password manager for a given site, it no longer autofills on that site and is completely removed from the password manager list in preferences, while other unrelated entries remain unaffected.

cases.title: Remove one of multiple credentials for the same site
cases.description: Verify that when multiple username and password pairs exist for a single site and one specific pair is removed, only that specific pair stops autofilling and disappears from the password manager list, while the remaining credentials for that site continue to function.

cases.title: Remove all saved credentials successfully
cases.description: Verify that when the user chooses to remove all username and password information, the password manager clears all stored data, stops autofilling credentials across all sites, and displays an empty list in the password manager preferences.

cases.title: Remove all credentials when the password store is already empty
cases.description: Verify that executing the remove all action on an already empty password store does not cause errors and leaves the password manager in a clean, empty state without autofill or listed items.

opinions.feedback: All proposed high-level test cases are well-structured, distinct, and directly traceable to their respective requirements without any confirmed blockers.
All test cases map correctly to the specified requirements, cover positive and negative scenarios, and are fully testable.

analysis.analysis: R-102: Testable behavior is discarding the password when Never For This Site is chosen. Boundary: existing stored credentials for the site remain unaffected. Normal path: user clicks Never For This Site, password is discarded and prompt does not reappear. Abnormal path: password is retained or prompt reappears. Ambiguity: Does Never For This Site block only the current credential or future ones too? R-103: Testable behavior is availability of multiple saved credentials. Boundary: zero, single, or multiple sets of credentials. Normal path: multiple choices are presented on login. Abnormal path: only one or none are available. Ambiguity: Sorting order and selection UI behavior when multiple exist. R-104: Testable behavior is updating the password when changed. Boundary: changing password vs updating username only. Normal path: user changes password, manager detects and updates/prompts to update. Abnormal path: old password retained, new password ignored. Ambiguity: Whether update is automatic or via prompt. R-105: Testable behavior is disabling password manager functionality. Boundary: settings toggle. Normal path: manager disabled, no save prompts, no autofill. Abnormal path: prompts still appear or info is prefilled. Ambiguity: What happens to existing stored data when disabled. R-106: Testable behavior is viewing saved credentials in preferences. Boundary: empty list vs populated list. Normal path: user opens preferences, saved credentials are visible. Abnormal path: saved credentials missing from list. Ambiguity: Masking or plain text display of passwords. R-107: Testable behavior is removing a specific credential. Boundary: removing single entry when multiple exist for a site. Normal path: entry removed, stops autofilling, removed from preferences. Abnormal path: entry still autofills or appears in list. Ambiguity: Behavior when removing the last credential for a site vs one of many. R-108: Testable behavior is removing all credential information. Boundary: clearing an empty store vs a fully populated store. Normal path: all data wiped, no autofill, preferences list empty. Abnormal path: partial data remains. Ambiguity: Confirmation dialog requirements before full deletion.
